member_projections.content: Summary projection anchored on plmm.product. Purpose: Landscape meta-model for the product portfolio. It composes Core models by reference to describe products, their relationships, capabilities and cross-product processes, and declares routing hints for resolution. Exported kinds: product, product-relationship, capability, cross-product-process, routing-hint. Identifiers plus a short summary under the just-in-time dereference rule; dereference any identifier for the full projection.

member_projections.content: Summary projection anchored on aismm.software-product. Purpose: Core domain meta-model for software products. member_projections.content: Summary projection anchored on collmm.collective. Purpose: Core meta-model for the Collective as one canonical primitive: a team or standing body that holds members, member roles and a mandate and builds products. It sits between the person and the organizational unit, binding member seats to OUMM established-positions and the parent unit to an OUMM org-unit. Exported kinds: collective, membership, member-role, collective-mandate. Identifiers plus a short summary under the just-in-time dereference rule; dereference any identifier for the full projection.

coverage_statement: Covers plmm.product, aismm.software-product, apmm.role, oumm.org-unit, collmm.collective as summary projections under the just-in-time dereference rule (v0.1 emits no full content: sync is git pull and members carry identifiers plus short summaries). Budget used 614 of 8000 tokens; no degradation occurred. observed_at is the caller-supplied stamp (deterministic, no wall clock); no staleness computed against sync_contract freshness in v0.1. Nothing else is reachable from the seed set along composes or references edges.
